title: Cardinality
summary: Cardinality compares collections by whether their elements can be paired exactly.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared set theory context is fixed.

content.plain: Cardinality compares collections by whether their elements can be paired exactly.
content.exact: Sets A and B have equal cardinality iff a bijection A→B exists. Infinite cardinal arithmetic requires an explicit foundation.
content.example: The even natural numbers and all natural numbers have equal cardinality via n↦2n.
content.caveat: Equal cardinality ignores order, geometry, and other structure.
